Oliver Crangle is a bitter, prejudiced man. Through unknown means, he intends to shrink every evil person in the world at four o'clock.
A young woman lying in a hospital bed, her head wrapped in bandages, awaits the outcome of a surgical procedure performed by the State in a last-ditch attempt to make her look 'normal'.
Old Ben, who is able to transform himself into anything, tries to help a crippled little girl.
A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.
A ventriloquist's dummy goads him into committing burglaries.
The daughter of an inventor objects to their 'perfect' home where they are waited on by mechanical servants.
Jared Garrity arrives in the Old West town of Happiness, Arizona, proclaiming he can revive the dead.
Corry is stranded on an asteroid after being convicted of a crime. He receives as a present a robot who looks, sounds, and acts like a real woman.
A pair of newlyweds stopping in a small town are trapped by their own superstition when playing a fortune-telling machine in a local diner.
A street salesman cleverly eludes Death. But if he lives, a little girl must die in his place.
A pioneer from a wagon train in 1847 sets off to find something for his ill son and stumbles into present-day New Mexico.
The curator of a murderers' row in a soon-to-be-defunct wax museum persuades the owner to let him keep the figures for awhile.
Tight fisted Franklin Gibbs is not pleased when his wife wins a trip for two to Las Vegas. But things change when he falls under the spell of a slot machine that calls his name.
When a newlywed couple briefly returns to the groom's childhood home, the ties of the past prove too strong to resist.
Fortune discovers that a piano he bought his wife for her birthday has magical properties - the music that it plays makes people reveal their true essence.
A man's wish to listen to loud noise backfires.
A mysterious guardian helps a tiny community survive after the Bomb destroys much of the Earth.
In 1942, a German wonders why he's on the deck of a British steamship, with no memory of how he got there, and an overwhelming sense of impending doom.
In a future totalitarian society, a librarian is declared obsolete and sentenced to death.
When a nuclear attack appears imminent, several suburban friends and neighbors fight over control of a single bomb shelter.
After being shot to death, Rocky Valentine encounters the amiable white-haired Mr. Pip, who gives Rocky everything he wishes for.
The Kanamits, 9-foot tall aliens, arrive on Earth with one lofty goal: To Serve Man.
A man finds that he can trade anything he has, including youth and personality, with anybody else.
A former Nazi SS Captain returns to the ruins of a concentration camp to reminisce and is met by one of his victims.
